transport: claude --model claude-sonnet-5 --output-format json --tools "" -p (prompt on stdin; user Pro/Max subscription, no API key)
gold_predicate: area==jd.area AND >=2 requiredSkills present AND years>=minYears (matchesJd; computed after the call, never in the prompt)
corpus_note: FIRST-N deterministic résumés (buildResume(i, seed)); first-N gold density for jd-en-backend is sparse (0@300, 0@1000, 1@3000, 3@3700, 6@6000, 13@10000).

analysis.tokens_per_resume_method: linear fit through exact CLI usage: (N=300, 98336 tok), (N=3000, 794989 tok), (N=3700, 973307 tok) => ~258 tok/résumé + ~21k fixed overhead; ~1.85 chars/token because the corpus is 31% CJK + 15% Vietnamese (dense), NOT the 40-120 tok/résumé an English-only assumption predicts
analysis.prompt_tokens_are_exact: prompt_tokens = usage.input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens from the claude CLI JSON (real tokenizer, not an estimate)
analysis.context_ceiling_modeled_method: largest N with 258*N + 21000 <= 1,000,000 => N ≈ 3,790; empirically fits at 3,700 (97.3% of window), hard-refuses at 3,800 with API 400 'Prompt is too long ... limit 1000000'
analysis.context_ceiling_is_jd_independent: the JD queryText is ~100 tokens, so the context ceiling is essentially identical for jd-vi-data-engineering and jd-ja-mobile; only accuracy would differ
analysis.overflow_behavior: Claude Code hard-refuses over-window prompts in ~2-3s with a 400 'Prompt is too long' and total_cost_usd=0 (single-exchange prompts cannot be compacted); no silent truncation observed (returned IDs were always in-range)
analysis.accuracy_note: Within the fittable range (N<=~3790) the first-N strict gold set is tiny (<=3), so a clean NDCG-vs-N accuracy-degradation curve is NOT measurable under first-N sampling. NDCG@10 = 0 (N=3000, 1 gold) and 0.469 (N=3700, 3 gold) reflect a GOLD-PREDICATE-vs-MODEL-JUDGMENT mismatch on rare needles, not a haystack-capacity failure: the model read and ranked the whole haystack (every returned ID was an in-range backend résumé carrying the JD's headline skills; e.g. its N=3000 #1 res-1592 had rust+kubernetes but 3 years, just failing the >=5yr gate, while the lone strict-gold res-1829 was a Rust-less/gRPC-less postgres+k8s backend eng that the model reasonably ranked lower). The context window, not accuracy, is the binding constraint.
analysis.comparison_to_old_300: The earlier claude-sonnet5-300.json (NDCG@10=1.0) used a CURATED sample-300 with 12 dense gold rows (4% density) — a floor, not a ceiling. The true single-pass in-context ceiling via the subscription CLI is ~3,700-3,800 résumés, bounded by the 1M-token window at ~258 tok per multilingual résumé.
analysis.raw_api_note: Via the raw Anthropic API (no Claude Code ~21k system/tool overhead) the ceiling would be only ~80 résumés higher (~3,870) — the dominant factor is the 258 tok/résumé density, not the CLI overhead. No ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was set, so the raw-API path was not exercised.

accuracy_ceiling: not-cleanly-measurable-under-first-N (gold too sparse within the window; context window is the binding constraint) — see analysis.accuracy_note
max_resumes_headline: ~3,800 résumés in one in-context pass (context-window-bound); confirmed fit at 3,700 (973,307 tok = 97.3% of 1M), hard refusal at 3,800
